dct_description_sm: A vegetation survey was completed in order to estimate current vegetation characteristics, such as species richness and percent cover, of various types of plants, as well as to monitor plant phenology over the growing season. Measurements were conducted within the 32 vegetation plots of the International Tundra Experiment (ITEX) site at Cape bounty, which were established in 2008, and also within 4 recently established additional control plots. This data set serves as the most recent vegetation assessment within these plots, the last of which was conducted in 2009. It will allow us to determine whether or not significant changes to the structure and dynamics of the vegetation communities have occurred after 7 years of experimental warming and enhanced snow deposition within these plots.
dct_title_s: 2015 ITEX Vegetation Survey, Cape Bounty, Nunavut
